title: Mrs. Greta's Stall

readiness.math: counting on from a price to give change
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: greta
intro.text: The market's busy! Will you help me serve? When someone pays, count the change on from the price.

intro.speaker: greta
intro.text: If it costs 3 and they give 5: four, five. That's two back.

steps.speaker: greta
steps.prompt: The {item} costs {price}. The customer gave you {paid}. Count the change, then press Give change.

feedback.all_good: What a helper! Every coin of change was right.

outro.speaker: greta
outro.text: You've a good head and an honest heart. Come back any market day!

journal_line: I helped Mrs. Greta serve at her stall in Bellhaven, counting the change.
unavailable_text: Mrs. Greta's stall is minded for today.
